label: Products
description: Manage a Supabase-backed product catalogue with products, variants, categories, brands, attributes and private product/variant image uploads.

instructions: Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Create a dedicated bearer token and install it in both the CMS secret store and the Supabase function secrets.
Install the products source and catalogue dashboard with the deployed function URL.
scopes: Product image uploads to Supabase Storage
checks: The CMS only stores the source configuration and private API key reference.
Write requests forward x-cms-user-id for audit context.
The connector schema stays private to anon and authenticated Supabase roles.
This catalogue module does not own prices, offers, vendors, orders, stock, payments, delivery, carts or reservations.
resources: Generated private CMS products API key
Private products schema, private product media bucket, and Edge Function
review: Keep the products schema private to anon and authenticated roles.
Keep Storage reads and writes behind the cms-products Edge Function so CMS source proxying can cache and transform images.
Do not expose Supabase service-role or secret keys to browser code.
Use external references only for import identity; this module does not own commerce orders or vendor offers.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns catalogue rows and the cms-products Edge Function owns access.

bloc.name: Product search
bloc.description: Form-associated product picker that searches the Products source and submits the selected product id.

meta.name: Upload product image
meta.description: Upload a product image to the private products-media bucket. The request must be multipart/form-data with a file field.

meta.name: Upload variant image
meta.description: Upload a variant image to the private products-media bucket. The request must be multipart/form-data with a file field.
